name: Web Theater
summary:
Web Theater is more than just a browser — it’s a premium online cinema system, seamlessly integrated into Moon Player’s immersive environments.
With Web Theater, you can stream content from platforms like YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+, Hulu, Paramount+, Apple TV+, Plex, and Tubi — all within your private Moon Player theater, no downloads needed. It lets you browse the web freely while enjoying the cinematic atmosphere Moon Player is known for.
